name: Guthril
description: Captured werewolf who reverted for three lunar cycles, then re-emerged stronger and destroyed Glick's laboratory.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alchemist Theodora Glick forces the captured Guthril to stay human for three lunar cycles, but he re-emerges and destroys her laboratory in Gavony.
timeline.quote: He utterly destroyed Glick's laboratory in Gavony and fled into the night.
